implementationDetails.audioStrategy: Three offline recorded banks. Salamander C5 uses five recorded dynamics with crossfades between layers. Upright Piano KW uses two recorded dynamics. Rhodes Mark I uses one recorded dynamic, velocity-sensitive gain and filtering, and the author’s sustain loops at runtime. Nearby roots are transposed during playback. Clavinet, FM Stage Piano, Rosewood Marimba and the fallback are synthesized. Organ and Synth generate audio at runtime and share the piano AudioContext and master limiter. Organ A and B share one effects chain. Piano A/B and Synth A/B/C each have independent chains.
